app.name: Boltget
status.connected_hint: Downloads that match your rules go to Boltget.
status.not_running_hint: It starts on its own when a download arrives.
status.not_installed_hint: Downloads stay in the browser until you install the app.
status.app_too_old_hint: This extension is newer than the app. Update Boltget to keep sending downloads.
status.extension_too_old_hint: The app is newer than this extension. Update the extension in your browser.
status.mismatch_hint: Its parts come from different releases. Install the latest Boltget again.
status.unreachable_hint: Downloads stay in the browser for now.
popup.capture_on: Big files and the types you chose go to Boltget.
popup.capture_off: Every download stays in the browser.
popup.access_hint: Without it, files behind a sign-in may fail in Boltget.
notice.media_unsupported: Sending a whole page arrives with video support. For now, right-click a link and choose Download with Boltget.
notice.media_excluded: Sending pages isn’t available on this site.
notice.link_kept: Boltget couldn’t take this link, so the browser is downloading it.
notice.links_failed: Boltget couldn’t take these links. Check that it’s installed and try again.
notice.page_failed: Boltget couldn’t take this page. Check that it’s installed and try again.
notice.no_links: There are no links to download here.
options.title: Boltget for your browser
welcome.title: Boltget is ready
welcome.body: Big downloads in this browser now go to Boltget, which fetches them faster and can resume them. One choice is yours to make.
access.title: Site access
access.body: Many files download only when you are signed in. To fetch them as the browser would, Boltget needs the site’s cookies and the headers the browser sent. With access, the extension reads them for the downloads it hands to Boltget, and only those, and passes them straight to the Boltget app on this computer. Nothing goes anywhere else.
access.missing: Not allowed. Downloads still go to Boltget, but without cookies, so files behind a sign-in may fail there. Alt and Alt+Shift on links also need access.
connection.title: Connection
rules.title: What goes to Boltget
rules.min_size_hint: Smaller files finish faster in the browser. Files whose size the browser doesn’t know go by type alone.
rules.extensions_hint: Without dots, separated by spaces or commas.
rules.private_hint: Also send downloads from private windows. The browser must allow the extension in them as well.
rules.edited: You changed these rules here; Boltget’s own are kept aside.
sites.title: Sites
sites.never_hint: One site per line, such as your bank. Its subdomains are included.
sites.always_hint: Every download from these sites goes to Boltget, whatever its type or size.
keys.title: Keys
keys.modifiers_hint: Hold Alt while clicking a link to keep it in the browser, or Alt+Shift to send it to Boltget whatever the rules say.
